Sandbox_QuickCrafting.Enabled_tooltip: Shortens hand crafting actions. Other timed actions are not affected.
Sandbox_QuickCrafting.TimePercent_toolti: Recipes run at this share of their normal duration. At 10, a 40 second recipe takes 4 seconds. At 100, nothing changes.
Sandbox_QuickCrafting.MaxSeconds_tooltip: Optional limit applied after the scaling, for recipes that stay long even once shortened.
